comment: OpenMontage API container. Docker's default profile also blocks the namespace calls bubblewrap needs to build each job's agent box, so this profile allows those and refuses the kernel-administration calls Docker refuses by default that nothing here uses. 64-bit x86 only. Run with: --security-opt seccomp=docker/seccomp-openmontage.json --security-opt systempaths=unconfined --security-opt apparmor=unconfined (see docs/API.md).
